p: land that shall fall unto you: Meaning, the description of the land.
river of Egypt: Which was Nilus, or as some think Rhinocotura.
great sea for a border: Which is called the Mediterranean.
Hor: Which is a mountain near Tyre and Sidon, and not that Hor in the wilderness where Aaron died.
Chinnereth eastward: Which in the Gospel is called the lake of Gennesaret.
prince of every tribe: One of the heads or chief men of every tribe.
divide the inheritance unto the children: And be judges over every piece of ground that should fall to any by lot, to the intent that all things might be done orderly and without contention.
